Description: Infection through contact in households, schools, workplaces, and the general community
Progression from latent to infectious state after incubation period
Recovery from infection

Name: R0
Description: Basic reproduction number; moderate scenario R0=1.7, high scenario R0=2.0

Name: Generation time
Description: Mean generation time of influenza transmission

Name: Clinical fraction
Description: Proportion of infected individuals who become clinical cases (ill enough to seek medical care)

Name: Household transmission fraction
Description: Proportion of transmission occurring within the household

Name: Community transmission fraction
Description: Proportion of non-household transmission occurring in the general community

Name: School and workplace transmission fraction
Description: Proportion of non-household transmission occurring in schools and workplaces

Name: School contact rate multiplier
Description: Per-capita contact rates in schools assumed to be double that in workplaces

Name: Vaccine efficacy (susceptibility reduction)
Description: Reduction in susceptibility conferred by a matched pandemic vaccine

Name: Vaccine efficacy (infectiousness reduction)
Description: Reduction in infectiousness for vaccinated individuals who still get infected

Name: Vaccine efficacy (clinical case reduction)
Description: Reduction in probability of becoming a clinical case for vaccinated individuals who get infected

Name: Pre-pandemic vaccine efficacy (susceptibility reduction)
Description: Reduction in susceptibility conferred by a pre-prepared vaccine against the source avian virus

Name: Vaccination rate
Description: Rate at which population can be vaccinated per day

Name: Vaccine protection delay
Description: Time after vaccination for protection to develop

Name: US population size
Description: Assumed population size of the United States

Name: GB population size
Description: Assumed population size of Great Britain

Name: Household quarantine compliance
Description: Proportion of households assumed to comply with voluntary quarantine policy

Name: Household quarantine external contact reduction
Description: Reduction in external contact rates for quarantined households

Name: Household quarantine internal contact increase
Description: Increase (100%) in within-household contact rates during quarantine

Name: Quarantine duration
Description: Duration of voluntary household quarantine
